findings.title: Specify failure handling for new config reads
findings.description: The design describes new reads from `.context-forge.local.toml` and the shared file, but its failure-mode section covers writes and `.gitignore` updates—not read failures in `ConfigManager.get` or the `ConsistencyChecker` scan. State how read errors are distinguished from a missing file and surfaced; otherwise an unreadable config could be mistaken for an absent value, undermining the promised compatibility fallback and migration warning.
